rules.title: Every block is a CAPA signal
rules.text: A broken premise, failed reproduction, tripped gate, conflict or recorded caveat emits or updates a local CAPA draft with its evidence. Nobody copies a log into an issue by hand.

rules.title: One draft per fingerprint
rules.text: A repeated failure updates its existing draft (same fingerprint: rule or gate plus subject) and counts the recurrence, instead of opening a second draft.

rules.title: A draft is a claim
rules.text: The harness writes drafts with status 'draft' only. A finding becomes evidence when CI-signed results back it and the owner promotes it; the harness never marks its own draft verified.
